mechanism_narrative: The current level of real GDP (GDPC1) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, producing positive 20-day returns regardless of the specific value of GDPC1.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals economic distress and reduced corporate earnings potential, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicates a strong monetary policy stance and labor market, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND UNRATE < 4.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising by more than 0.2% in the last 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced liquidity and increased risk aversion over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and rising > 0.2% in 3 months)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, producing positive 60-day returns regardless of the specific value of INDPRO.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1100 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong residential sales (RSAFS > 440000 million dollars) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 238) indicates a healthy economy with stable purchasing power, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 440000 AND CPIAUCSL < 238, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1100 thousand units and real GDP growth > 2% in the last quarter), the economy is overextended, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 1100 and GDPC1 growth > 2% in last quarter)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
